  shared manager). True teardown (`registry.destroyAll`/idle TTL) destroys the manager
  through `wire.destroy()`. Deterministic evidence: `page-collab.dom.test.tsx` (17 green —
  mount→type→unmount→remount same `data-page-session`, ⌘Z drains both the pre-leave marker
  and a post-remount edit; teardown destroys the manager). The SSR island keeps upstream
  `yUndoPlugin` semantics (single-mount lifecycle, unchanged). `R10.keepalive` stays
  `expected:"red"` until the deployed leg re-runs green. Original finding text:

  self-reported both gaps as blocking findings, entailment-capped `evidence_accuracy` +
  `originality_situatedness` at 2, and **auto-refunded both unclosed research phases**,
  REQ-SPEC-32 live); the defect is the **phase done-gate** — it should require >0 claims

  Y.Doc, so subsequent flushes re-persisted the pre-restore items and the stored
  `y_state` again contains the restored-away text (verified: marker bytes present in
  `y_state` while `md_sha256` is the restored sha; a **fresh** browser context still
  renders the removed text in `[data-page-view]`). Any client reconnecting mid-restore
  silently resurrects the content; the next materialize can write it back, un-applying
  the restore in storage too. Likely fix shape: the apply must evict/rebind the collab
  runtime (close + unload the document runtime, or version the doc identity) rather than
  only rewriting `y_state`. Owed: root-cause + fix ticket.

  post-deploy).** Root cause confirmed: the apply's wholesale `y_state` swap carried no
  tombstones (fresh-doc item ids) AND the loaded runtime's in-memory doc was never
  reconciled — a stale flush + a stale replica merge BOTH resurrected removed text.
  Fix: `live_docs.y_epoch` (migration 0059) + convergent restore — the api applies the
  restored markdown through `updateYFragment` over the STORED state (tombstoned items
  merge as deletions on every replica) and bumps the epoch in the same statement; the
  collab runtime records its loaded epoch and `convergeReplacedDoc` reconciles the
  in-memory doc (with a canonical-markdown convergence check for no-shared-history
  writes) at the top of `storeDocument`, `markRestorePoint`, and `beforeSync` SS1 —
  so no stale flush ever reaches `live_docs` and reconnects converge before their
  first sync reply. Deterministic tests: api apply → epoch bump + tombstoned merge;
  collab out-of-band restore → store flushes restored bytes; real-provider reconnect
  over a socket converges to restored content. Owed: live re-proof post-deploy
  (rides the next deploy's image set).
  **RESOLVED 2026-10-27 (R6DEP.3, prod `dc3a8f6` — `runs/R6DEP.3.md`,
  `reports/2026-10-27_R6DEP.3/restore-reproof/`).** Live re-proof PASSED on prod:
  named restore point → typed marker → UI restore apply → `live_docs.y_epoch`
  0→1 exactly once + stored `y_state` clean of the restored-away marker; the
  still-loaded collab runtime's post-restore flush wrote the next edit with the
  marker still absent (no stale-flush resurrection); a second tab in the same
  browser context — a stale y-indexeddb replica — reconnected through SS1 and
  rendered restored content only. CONVERGED end-to-end.

- **F-R6DEP3-1 — RESOLVED-IN-CODE 2026-10-27 (R6FIX.3 — `runs/R6FIX.3.md`,
  branch `stevevitali/r6fix-3-meter-race`).** Root cause (real prod rows,
  system-DSN): NOT a terminal-flush race — every debit AND every proxy
  `usage_records` row landed before finalize; the charge (505) is correct
  committed-mode semantics (per-phase `max(pod claim, metered − debited)`
  floors sum above `max(Σ claims 464, Σ metered 502)` — ECON.1 D-F). The bug:
  `reconcileRunSpend` rebuilt `spent_credits` as `greatest(claims, Σ usage)`
  and never folded the ledger's net charge, so the committed meter
  (card/`cost.final`/SSR) under-reported what was debited. Fix: the net
  committed charge (Σ debit − Σ refund) joins the `greatest()` write — monotone,
  refund-netting keeps absorbed burn the floor; 4 deterministic tests incl. the
  canary's exact 464/502/505 shape; corrected formula over the real rows = 505
  = the charged figure. Deployed re-proof owes the next DEP ticket. _Original
  entry (2026-10-27, R6DEP.3 live-found on prod `dc3a8f6` — `runs/R6DEP.3.md`,
  `reports/2026-10-27_R6DEP.3/r6-canary/`): the completed canary run's report
  charged **505 cr** (`data-estimate-line` "…505 cr spent") while the run
  card's terminal committed meter showed **502 cr** — a 3-cr debit (`$0.03`)
  the live meter never rendered, tripping the R6 leg's strict
  `reportSpent > finalSpent` assert ("a charge no meter recorded", REQ-SPEC-32
  shape)._

  which cannot be price-switched in place) → `D-R6FIX.5-1` OPEN. Owed:
  deployed cancel re-proof + the Price-registry ticket.
